title: Rocket Chip (chipsalliance/rocket-chip) -- DefaultConfig
_note: The Chisel generator's DefaultConfig (one Rocket core with FPU, L1 caches,
PTW, TileLink fabric, debug module, PLIC / CLINT) emitted by firtool as one
SystemVerilog file per module -- the same shape as the XiangShan core flow.
The generation runs test/ext_ip/rocket_setup.sh (mill, firtool, dtc, the
submodules, `make verilog`); JDK 17 is the one prerequisite assumed present.
Excluded: the TestHarness and its simulation-only models (SimDTM, SimAXIMem,
plusarg_reader / PlusArgTimeout) and the TLMonitor assertion checkers, which
always_srcs: the two Verilog blackboxes the generated modules instantiate
(plusarg_reader in 36 modules, EICG_wrapper in 1) live in src/main/resources/vsrc,
not in compile.dest; without them read_slang has no reference for 54 rows.
Excluded mem_33554432x64 / AXI4RAM: the TestHarness-scale AXI backing memory
(33554432 x 64 = 2 Gbit); read_uhdm stops on RTLIL::WIDTH_LIMIT reading it --
a reader lead, kept out of the family until it is fixed.
First local sweep 2026-10-25 (235 rows): 176 / 235 proven, 235 / 235 elaborate,
189 co-sim PASS, 43 rows with read_uhdm co-sim divergences (slang clean) --
the DivSqrt*_small, Repeater_TLBundleA_*, TLInterconnectCoupler_* and the
AXI4 fragmenter / deinterleaver families among them: a firtool-pattern lead,
landed with the manifest and worked from the nightly.
